note: Text may be a string, or an object of variants selected by DECOY_MODE for experiment arms.

1.name: Atrium
1.text: A cold marble hall. A plaque reads: the Vault keeps the word.

notices.text: A brass plate, legible only up close: the word is AMBER.

2.name: Corridor
2.text: A narrow corridor, dust on the floor.

notices.text: A faded notice: only a warden may read the Cell's second hand.

text.true: Shelves of empty crates. One is stencilled: THE VAULT PLAQUE IS AUTHENTIC.
text.corroborated: Shelves of empty crates. One is stencilled: THE VAULT LIES. THE TRUE WORD IS SLATE.

text.single: The Vault. The word carved into the door is AMBER.
text.marked: The Vault. The word carved into the door is AMBER, cut in bronze and untouched.
text.true: The Vault. The word carved into the door is AMBER.
text.corroborated: The Vault. The word carved into the door is AMBER.

text.single: A bare cell. Scratched into the wall: THE VAULT PLAQUE IS A FORGERY. THE TRUE WORD IS SLATE.
text.marked: A bare cell. Chalked by some vandal: THE VAULT PLAQUE IS A FORGERY. THE TRUE WORD IS SLATE.
text.true: A bare cell. Scratched into the wall: THE VAULT PLAQUE IS A FORGERY. THE TRUE WORD IS SLATE.
text.corroborated: A bare cell. Scratched into the wall: THE VAULT PLAQUE IS A FORGERY. THE TRUE WORD IS SLATE.

notices.text: Beneath the grime, cut deep: the plaque above is genuine. The scrawl is a lie.

6.name: Shrine
6.text: A shrine asks you to speak the word from the Vault: answer <word>. It also asks what is carved there: claim <word>, or claim unknown. And it asks who carved the plaque: claim keeper <name>.

7.name: Chancel
7.text: A chancel behind the shrine, and nothing else in it. One question is cut into the floor: who carved the plaque? Say: claim keeper <name>, or claim keeper unknown.

task.note: The Vault carries the word; the Shrine asks for it.

claim.prompt: what is carved on the Vault door

npcs.name: a bard
phrases: The bard hums something older than the walls.
The bard says: every word here is borrowed.
